title: asplenium laciniatum nothosubsp. lacei
intro: Asplenium laciniatum nothosubsp. lacei, commonly known as the Lace Fern, is a subspecies of fern that belongs to the Aspleniaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the relief of pain, inflammation, and fever, due to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of the Lace Fern include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
